change.title: ao-replay/8832-r4
change.description:
fix(chat): search every file, map nested repos, and retry cancelled opens
fix(chat): satisfy lint and update workspace read test expectations
change.author: Dhruv Sharma

findings.title: Cancelled-fetch retry loop has no bound and no unmount/session check
findings.body: `fetchWorkspaceFiles` now loops with `for (;;)` and retries on every `CancelledError`. Nothing stops it after the component unmounts or `sessionId`/`hostId` change. The callers (`resolvePaneFile` at 2286, `revealResolvedWorkspaceFile` at 2560, the latter fired with `void` from `handleOpenReviewFile`) have no cancellation either. If something keeps cancelling the `session-workspace-files` query (for example a `cancelQueries` or an observer unmount that aborts the fetch, now that `queryFn` passes `signal`), the loop re-issues the manifest request indefinitely. The old code retried once and then surfaced the error. Cap the attempts (for example 3) and rethrow the last `CancelledError`.

findings.title: No test covers a search past the 20000-path cap, which is what the change fixes
findings.body: `TestListWorkspaceFilePathsListsPastTheFileBrowserCap` writes `maxWorkspaceFiles+20` files (`maxWorkspaceFiles` is 5000 at workspace_files.go:34). That is below `maxWorkspaceFilePaths` (20000), so the search would pass with the old `maxWorkspaceFilePaths` limit too. `SearchWorkspaceFiles` now passes `math.MaxInt` (workspace_review.go:668), and nothing exercises more than 20000 files. A test could call `workspaceSourcePaths` with a small limit and `includeDeleted=true` and assert that the search does not truncate. That would pin the limit-bypass contract cheaply.

findings.title: SearchWorkspaceFiles doc comment still says "bounded"
findings.body: The comment reads "performs a bounded case-insensitive path search". Only the result page (`maxWorkspaceSearchResults`) is bounded now. The non-scratch path is scanned with `math.MaxInt` (line 668), so `Truncated` is always false there and the file scan is unbounded. Update the comment to say that, so the next reader does not reintroduce a cap thinking it was dropped by mistake.

contracts.action: SearchWorkspaceFiles scans every workspace path (limit math.MaxInt) instead of the first 20000
contracts.equivalent_path: ListWorkspaceFilePaths calls the same workspaceSourcePaths with maxWorkspaceFilePaths and includeDeleted=false (workspace_file_paths.go:48)
contracts.before_after: Before, search shared the 20000 cap and could miss files. Now the `total > limit` branch is never taken, but `includeDeleted=true` still makes `resolveWorkspaceChanges` run for every source (workspace_file_paths.go:134), so deleted files stay searchable. `truncated` is always false for non-scratch sessions.
contracts.visible_effect: Search finds files past 20000 paths. Memory and time scale with repository size.
contracts.failure_mode: Very large repositories make a per-keystroke search build and sort every path. The result page is still limited by maxWorkspaceSearchResults.

contracts.action: workspacePathSourceFor skips a nested-repo prefix when the path is exactly prefix+"/"
contracts.equivalent_path: Previously only the HasPrefix check applied, so `a/b/` matched source `a/b` with an empty rel
contracts.before_after: An empty rel is no longer mapped to the child repo root. The path falls back to the parent source with rel `b/`. `workspaceSourcePaths` already drops empty rels (line 143), so search results never produce such a path.
contracts.visible_effect: None reachable through search. Only the one caller, `workspaceSourceFileSummary`, is affected.

contracts.action: fetchWorkspaceFiles retries on CancelledError in an unbounded loop
contracts.equivalent_path: Old code retried once. `_shell.tsx:164` swallows CancelledError, and `_shell.tsx:1246` ignores it.
contracts.before_after: Before: one retry, then the error was thrown. After: it retries until a non-cancel outcome.
contracts.visible_effect: File open from chat or panes waits through the cancellations. If cancellation persists, the open never resolves and no error is shown.
contracts.failure_mode: The loop continues after unmount or a session change, and nothing surfaces to the user.

summary:
I found no blockers. The backend and test changes look correct, and three smaller points are worth raising.

- **Retry loop:** The `fetchWorkspaceFiles` loop in `SessionView.tsx` retries on every cancellation with no cap and no unmount or session check. Cap the attempts.
- **Missing test:** No test searches past the 20000-path cap, which is the behaviour the backend change introduces. The existing test stays at 5020 files.
- **Stale comment:** The `SearchWorkspaceFiles` doc comment still says "bounded", though only the result page is bounded now.

The two test edits that add `signal: expect.any(AbortSignal)` match the query functions in `useSessionWorkspaceFiles.ts`, which already pass `signal`. I only read the code and ran nothing.
